instructions: Use the existing published exporter and promotion preparation script with the exact pinned source hashes and their existing reproduction documentation. No additional executable materializer is supplied.

RAW must be a fresh ignored directory with the two command log directories present; required-output and promotion-source output directories must not exist. Do not overwrite an earlier capture.

Historical export requires the original raw required-gate captures and a separately reviewed local input join. Path rebasing needs a new explicit input hash; never generate historical receipts from summaries.
The helper invocation retains the existing outer40-second TERM/10-second KILL pattern and each unchanged20CPU/30wall/16MiB request. The actual outer records contain exit only, not argv.
Run each reporting request once through the existing helper and require raw exit0, clean ECHILD/no descendants, unchanged inputs, exact stdout/stderr hashes and the declared output inventories.
For promotion, stop after the generator prints its newly prepared request path; running that formatter request would be a separate new qualification command, not this reporting control.
Retain the exact distinction between committed exporter at ed67 and private snapshot preparation script. A later publication commit does not retroactively become the tested revision.
